milestone: M1 - OLMoE end-to-end in llama.cpp fork, experts streamed from GGUF
model: allenai/OLMoE-1B-7B-0125-Instruct-GGUF Q4_K_M (4.21 GB, 16 layers x 64 experts, k=8)
machine: MacBook Air M2 16GB, CPU backend only, n_ubatch=1 decode

gate.criterion: FNV-1a hash over every generated position's full logit vector, 33 positions, resident vs slots32 vs slots12, all with weight repacking disabled
gate.result: PASS - all three bit-identical (b6869f5b6ef36376), generated text identical
gate.mechanism_probe: cb_eval swap test on stock llama.cpp: in-place id mutation propagates, logits checksum unchanged (M1-A pass)
gate.extents_check: 24/24 per-expert slice hashes match independent gguf-py reader

root_cause_note: initial gate FAIL was llama.cpp ARM weight repacking (use_extra_bufts): repacked resident tensors use interleaved-gemm kernels with different float accumulation order than the plain vec_dot path slot tensors take. Low-order-bit logit differences, zero token-level effect (32/32 greedy tokens identical). Bisection: dup-only == resident (graph change innocent), slots32 == slots12 == identity64 (slot machinery consistent), bytes proven identical.

comparisons.vs_m0_io_only_prediction: M0 predicted 20.9 tok/s at trace hit 0.826; live decode hit is 0.891, I/O-only ceiling at measured bw = ~36 tok/s; 28.3 measured implies mostly-serial fetch+compute - overlap/prefetch is the M2 prize
comparisons.vs_stock_llama_cpp_best: 28.3/45.2 = 63% of fully-resident speed with half the expert RAM; 9.1/45.2 = 20% with 18% of expert RAM; both bit-identical quality

methodology_notes: cold = fresh F_NOCACHE copy of the GGUF per run (macOS serves F_NOCACHE reads from cache if pages exist; first run after copy showed 39.3 tok/s inflated by write-behind cache, rejected)
same n_ubatch on both sides of every hash comparison (accumulation order depends on it)
miss counts identical across repeat runs - cache behavior deterministic

files.fork_branch: vendor/llama.cpp branch llmstream (5 files, ~135 insertions, staged; private fork, never pushed upstream)
